The '''Verossia system''' was located in the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the devices known as [[Verossian computer]]s.<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Verossian computer]]s|system=Verossia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Verossia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-7.<ref name="TEA" />
